test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Sultry Days’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shobhaa De.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shobhaa De** is a freelance journalist and writer.
 
• She also **worked as a model in the past** and has been working in the field of **writing for the last four decades.**
 
• Shobhaa De has **edited popular magazines such as Celebrity, Stardust, and Society.**
 
• She is best known for her** depiction of socialites and sex in her works of fiction**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/175b8b923dc6ef66280ec42e57f89b69b274503dee294a59fd940881c9094a8d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Anita Nair** is an Indian novelist** **who writes her books in English. 
 
• She is best known for her novels** A Better Man, Mistress, and Lessons in Forgetting.**** **
 
• **Nikita Singh** is an Indian writer. 
 
• She has written twelve books as well as **The Reason is You, Every Time It Rains, Like a Love Song, The Promise, and After All This Time.**
 
• **Judy Balan is a comedy writer** and author who debuted with the bestselling novel **Two Fates: The Story of My Divorce, a parody of Chetan Bhagat's Two States: The Story of My Marriage.**
